proposed.title: Marvel Zombies#1
proposed.text: Years later, Okoye is a zombie herself but keeps her mind, and she leads a horde that includes the zombie Captain America and Hawkeye against the North Institute for Wanda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fallen heroes Okoye later leads in Wanda's horde.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Turned herself, she later leads them for Wanda.

changes.evidence: Infected by the zombie Wanda at Camp Lehigh in What If...?#5, Okoye returns in Marvel Zombies#1 as Wanda's scion leading a horde that includes the zombified Steve Rogers and Clint Barton against the North Institute; she takes Hawkeye back from Melina's control. Enemy becomes leader of the group.

proposed.title: Marvel Zombies#4
proposed.text: Years later, Hope is a zombie too, and she fights alongside the zombie Avengers in Wanda's horde in Paris.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Earth's heroes turned zombies, whom Hope later joins in Wanda's horde.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Later a zombie, she joins them in Wanda's horde.

changes.evidence: Hope turns after her death at Camp Lehigh (What If...?#5). In Marvel Zombies#4 the zombie Wasp is part of Wanda's army in the Paris battle for the Infinity Hulk (she goes after Spider-Man and Scott), the same horde that includes the zombie Hawkeye. Former enemy now fights on their side.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#9
proposed.text: Hunting Apocalypse, Cable ambushes Warren and learns that Dr. Adler, whose cure Warren backs, has moved to Muir Island.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ambushes Warren to find Dr. Adler.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The backer of Dr. Adler's cure, whom Cable ambushes.

changes.evidence: In 'The Cure' (#9), Warren has been funding Dr. Adler's cure; Cable ambushes Archangel and learns the doctor has relocated to Muir Island. They meet well before X-Men '97#11.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#30
proposed.text: Sean is Moira's fiance and helps her run her mutant research center on Muir Island, where Xavier comes to rest.

changes.evidence: Banshee first appears in 'The Phoenix Saga, Part II: The Dark Shroud' (#30, season 3 episode 4), where Xavier withdraws to Muir Island under Moira's care; Marvel Database cites that episode for Sean being engaged to Moira and helping her run the Muir Island center. Both are also there in #31. The current first stage is #56.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#21
proposed.text: Beast makes a vaccine from Wolverine's blood that stops the plague Apocalypse unleashes, and Apocalypse slips away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His plague is stopped by Beast's vaccine.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Makes the vaccine against Apocalypse's plague.

changes.evidence: In 'Time Fugitives' (#20-21), Apocalypse releases a genetically engineered plague; Bishop saves Beast from being infected, and in Part II Beast creates a vaccine from Wolverine's antibodies, after which Apocalypse escapes rather than pursue the X-Men. This is before the current first stage (#35).

proposed.title: X-Men '97#1
proposed.text: Xavier's will makes Magneto the leader of the X-Men, and Beast serves on the team under him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Beast's team under Xavier's will.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of the X-Men Magneto leads.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97#1 ends with Magneto revealing that Xavier's will gave him control of the X-Men and the school; in #2 he leads the team, with Beast among them (Beast tells Storm her powers are gone). Allies against the Phalanx become leader and team member.

proposed.title: X-Men '97#14
proposed.text: Stranded in ancient Egypt, Beast builds a time device from Apocalypse's Ship, and Magneto uses it to send him and the others home before Apocalypse kills Magneto.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sends Beast home from ancient Egypt, then dies at Apocalypse's hands.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Builds the time device Magneto uses to send him home.

changes.evidence: 'Rise of Apocalypse' Part 2 (#14): Beast uses parts of Ship to create a time travel device and Magneto sends the others back to the 1990s; Apocalypse then kills Magneto. (Between #1 and #14 Magneto turns from the X-Men in #8-9; Beast's own part there is not clear in the sources, so no stage is proposed for it.)

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#14
proposed.text: Sinister has the brainwashed Morph sabotage the Danger Room, and Beast nearly dies before he escapes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Nearly kills Beast with a Danger Room trap.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Nearly killed by Sinister's Danger Room trap.

changes.evidence: 'Till Death Do Us Part' (#14-15): Mister Sinister uses a brainwashed Morph to distract the X-Men and nearly kills Beast by sabotaging the Danger Room; in Part II Beast escapes. Enemies long before they team up against the Phalanx (#67).

proposed.title: X-Men '97#1
proposed.text: Hiding in a Sahara junkyard, Trask has Sentinels and a Master Mold again, and they fight the X-Men until he is captured.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trask's creations, which he sets against the X-Men again.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Their maker, hiding with them in the Sahara.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97#1: the X-Men locate Sentinel creator Trask at a junkyard in the Sahara, destroy several Sentinels and a Master Mold supercomputer there, and apprehend him; Marvel Animated wiki: 'Trask would later get his hands on another Master Mold in the Sahara Desert and his sentinels faced off against the X-Men.' After Master Mold turned on him (#13), he is back in command of Sentinels.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#76
proposed.text: Scott, Logan and Jean slip into Genosha to tell Magneto that Xavier is dying, and he calls off his invasion out of respect for his old friend.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Calls off his invasion when Scott tells him Xavier is dying.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Brings Magneto word that Xavier is dying.

changes.evidence: 'Graduation Day' (#76): on the eve of Magneto's invasion, Cyclops, Wolverine and Jean infiltrate Genosha to tell Magneto that Xavier is dying, and he halts the assault; he then stands with the X-Men as Xavier leaves. They are enemies throughout the original series (Magneto declares the X-Men his enemies in #3), long before the current first stage in X-Men '97.

owner_calls.question: In X-Men '97#7, after Rogue drops Trask to his death, his hidden programming makes him a Prime Sentinel (a human-Sentinel hybrid) under Bastion, and Cable stops him with an EMP. Should this be a stage, and if so with what kind?
options: Add a stage at X-Men '97#7 (kind enemy: the machines take him over)
Add a stage at X-Men '97#7 (kind ally: he becomes one of them)
No stage: the X-Men '97#1 stage covers it
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97#7: 'Rogue drops Trask to his death, unknowingly activating programming that turns him into a human-Sentinel hybrid. Cable arrives, defeats Trask with an EMP.'
